charnia.claim: Original simplified Charnia masoni fossil-form study informed by Dunn et al2019 Fig1F, explicitly identified BGS GSM105873 latex mould. Not exact specimen facsimile or scan. Genus-level scientific affinity uncertain; institutional Animalia catalog grouping is not settled phylogeny. Illustrative fossil length0.21m and slab0.12x0.26x0.012m, not measured dimensions of BGS specimen. Actual fossil relief and preservation do not establish living tissue thickness, color, posture or unseen rear face. Slab underside is artistic rock, not organism underside. Holotype conflict resolved for this asset by NOT selecting holotype: paper LEIUG2328 and GB3D SM A48259 catalog identities are not equated and neither is the modeled specific reference.
charnia.decisions: Concept has attractive slab relief but too many thin fern-like leaflets, invented central stalk, reconstructed basal disk and hand. Remove hand/stalk/disk; use broad tightly packed sigmoidal alternating units, nested shorter secondary furled ridges inside units, shallow negative integral relief. Axial slight bend indicates preservation only, not movement. Fossil no photographic grain. Slab thin with irregular corners; source Fig1F latex mould tonal polarity is not copied as exact fossil morphology. No equivalence between GB3D SM A48259 and paper LEIUG2328 asserted; BGS GSM105873 caption unambiguous.
sources: Anatomy of the Ediacaran rangeomorph Charnia masoni

inselberg.claim: Original generic geological-form analog of isolated residual rock hill. Government definition and official park photographs inform form, not geological period, named-site DEM, precise dimensions, cultural detail or coexisting ecosystem. Nominal module1100x900x180m with rock roughly500x350x170m, illustrative not measured. No universally igneous origin asserted; public broad Uluru silhouette and Bald Rock granite flank are separate examples, not conflated lithology or site reconstruction.
inselberg.decisions: Retain isolated asymmetrical hill and low plain from concept; round the overly planar top to unequal continuous convex crest, remove loose huge angular talus and square plaque. Integral irregular plain perimeter with low thickness, sparse shallow weathering grooves on hill. Not batch78 exfoliation dome: no giant shell, no concentric sheets; isolation and abrupt foot diagnostic. Public view of Uluru used only broad isolation, no exact form or restricted detail.

patterned-stone-circles.claim: Generic original frost sorted ground process/form concept informed by University Washington primary field photo and study explanation. patterned-stone-circles.decisions: Concept supports unequal partly shared coarse margins and fine centers. Reduce oversized boulders to small varied gravel/clasts and avoid mathematically perfect isolated rings. Margins broad and diffuse; dense integral faceted clast-like relief eliminates overlapping coplanar rock skins. Five centers with unequal ellipticity and scalloped boundaries, sparse small particles within fine centers. No vegetation or mechanical walls.

valley-glacier.claim: Original generic geological-form analog of valley glacier informed by NPS Fraser Glacier photograph and valley-versus-piedmont explanation. Not Fraser Glacier reconstruction, exact DEM, current retreat/melting chronology or assigned prehistoric period/ecosystem. Illustrative nominal900x1600x350m landscape, ice width roughly250m, no exact site measurement. Continuous full volume ice surface visible above valley floor, side bedrock rises higher. Crevasses shallow subordinate relief, not deep cuts severing tongue.
valley-glacier.decisions: Keep concept long confined continuous ice and mountain shoulders. Simplify unnecessary grass, tributary tributary complexity and too-dense terminal ice teeth. Unequal lower transverse crevasses integrated into same ice surface volume, visible blunt confined terminus before short forevalley, lateral debris narrow. No disconnected blocks or broad foreland lobe, no regular grid. Terrain and ice share boundary without exposed coplanar overlapping faces, one integrated solid landscape mesh.
